scene_description: A woman wearing yellow rubber gloves and a pink sweater is kneeling on a kitchen floor, holding a mop head. Next to her is a cleaning cart with blue and red buckets and a mop with a blue handle. The kitchen has white cabinets and countertops with various items on them.

questions.question: Where is the woman cleaning?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the cabinets and counters around her to figure out what room this is.

questions.question: What are the yellow gloves for?
sample_answers: so her hands don't get dirty
